author: IGN
description: Animal Crossing: New Horizons got a huge update on Switch 1 as well as a Switch 2 Edition, and it’s time to talk all about it! Join Logan Plant, Rebekah Valentine, and Peer Schneider as they share impressions of the new features like a hotel to decorate and Nintendo items to display, and some big quality of life updates to crafting and decorating. But the big question is, is this enough to bring people back?
title: Animal Crossing: New Horizons’ Big Update and Switch 2 Edition Impressions - NVC Clips

author: IGN
description:
Check out the launch trailer for the newest Once Human update, Visional Wheel Season 3, which adds enemy fusion mechanics that allow you to “fuse” with enemy monsters and utilize their different abilities to the post-apocalyptic open-world multiplayer survival game. Visional Wheel Season 3 drops on January 21. Check it out on Steam if you're interested: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2139460/Once_Human/

title: Once Human: Visional Wheel Season 3 – Official Launch Trailer
